content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Briarstone Beverage Company's operating results improved over the year to September 30, 2026: revenue, EBITDA and net income all rose, and leverage declined. Both financial covenants were met, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculations. The most important change is on the revolving line, which is over-advanced, with availability at {{fact:47c5f695-e47b-4894-ac60-e0a1ba696867}} as of September 30, 2026. A decision has already been recorded that a paydown is required. Reviewers should confirm how that decision is being carried out."},{"section":"performance","body":"Trailing twelve-month revenue rose to {{fact:7521515c-c229-45f3-8295-21f65b7777ac}} from {{fact:f78c6212-047b-4c4b-b567-b59815bfa1a0}}, growth of {{fact:492b5cff-0033-4c80-bad7-f1970988a6ac}}. EBITDA increased to {{fact:86f0fc0f-87cf-44e3-9791-4cfafc5c5378}} from {{fact:4e78ccca-f016-418f-b3d7-98f030694092}}, and the margin edged up to {{fact:d86ca4ac-3f65-45dc-9518-4414463b74ea}} from {{fact:34eaa89b-a2be-4d37-9bcb-0c2396aed147}}. Net income rose to {{fact:0b5af7a6-9c14-4971-80eb-17d0a9bad781}} from {{fact:0b018487-226d-4043-b60c-9bce434bbc78}}. Total debt fell to {{fact:48a67cec-2630-4f11-8f19-bbec6a100791}} from {{fact:325062ea-be71-4e3c-b703-93fe48b32ac3}}, and interest coverage improved to {{fact:729c65c6-3727-4349-ae59-f74c925e0071}} from {{fact:203a2313-cb4b-438a-b942-8eab49547359}}. Working capital was little changed. The current ratio was {{fact:8e4c72c2-0e48-4304-a817-f489b7f71528}} against {{fact:1c3d2962-ab3c-46dc-a77e-7cc53e3f307d}}, DSO lengthened slightly to {{fact:b7fe2db2-d4ef-4db7-88e0-0bbda7c98384}}, and DPO held at {{fact:c572406e-1642-4103-9ae7-a8c050aa5d2d}}. Cash was {{fact:79b082fc-8d0e-4b24-b0c1-58dfc886687e}}, up from {{fact:2538fc14-9f31-499a-a8bc-8f9d131f8660}}."},{"section":"covenants","body":"The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio was calculated at {{fact:de0d0994-2b88-4300-8298-45710f7c6503}} against a minimum of {{fact:e497cdc6-ce8f-440e-8246-39fdd45a7d98}}, which is compliant with a cushion of {{fact:42734413-344e-4af6-83d6-2fe2e9088bcd}}. The certificate reports {{fact:9d296127-464d-4ba8-bef6-7da0caa1bcd5}}, consistent with the bank's figure. The Total Leverage Ratio was calculated at {{fact:0162f859-0ef1-45ad-811d-d943be244691}} against a maximum of {{fact:01eb6a44-0aaf-4549-bd1e-bdc731013c73}}, which is compliant with a cushion of {{fact:dba5fabd-15ac-4831-8a4b-971e5f19ebce}}. The certificate reports {{fact:ebc014b9-8c11-496a-ba02-9e4879f24a23}}, also consistent. The certificate claims compliance on both covenants, and the bank's calculations agree."},{"section":"collateral","body":"The borrowing base as of September 30, 2026 shows the revolving line over-advanced, with availability at {{fact:47c5f695-e47b-4894-ac60-e0a1ba696867}}. Outstandings exceed eligible collateral, so there is no liquidity cushion on the line. No mismatched lines were identified in the borrowing base. The facts given do not show whether the shortfall comes from higher borrowings or from a decline in eligible receivables and inventory. Reviewers may wish to examine the borrowing base detail to establish the cause."},{"section":"risks","body":"The most significant item is the over-advance on the revolving line, raised as a critical work item. A decision has been recorded that a paydown is required, and reviewers should confirm its status and timing. A related medium-severity signal fired for low availability, which stands at {{fact:47c5f695-e47b-4894-ac60-e0a1ba696867}}. No other early warning signals fired. The current ratio of {{fact:8e4c72c2-0e48-4304-a817-f489b7f71528}} indicates limited working capital cover alongside the lack of availability on the line."}]}
